调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success. Any other value indicates failure. You can use this field to determine the cause of the failure
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

AutoConfig.description_en:
The JSON string for the automatic scan configuration. The fields are described as follows:

autoInclude: Specifies whether to enable automatic scanning. Valid values: true: enabled. false: disabled.
autoRule: The enablement configuration.
ruleOperator: The rule for the enablement configuration. Set the value to include.
operator: The logical operator. Set the value to or.
rule: The rule.
condition: The rule condition. Valid values: vendor: vendor, assetType: level-1 asset type, assetSubType: level-2 asset type.
For more information, refer to the [GetCloudAssetCriteria](~~GetCloudAssetCriteria~~) operation
AutoConfig.description_zh:
自动扫描配置JSON字符串。字段说明如下：

autoInclude：是否开启自动扫瞄，取值：true：开启，false：关闭。
autoRule：开启配置。
ruleOperator：开启配置规则，取值为include。
operator：逻辑运算符，取值：or。
rule：规则。
condition：规则条件，取值：vendor：厂商，assetType：一级资产类型，assetSubType：二级资产类型。
具体含义参考接口[GetCloudAssetCriteria](~~GetCloudAssetCriteria~~)

AutoType.description_en:
The type of the automatic scan configuration. Valid values:
0: disable automatic scanning
1: automatically scan new cloud assets
AutoType.description_zh:
自动扫描配置类型。取值：
0：关闭自动扫描
1：自动扫描新增云资产

Type.description_en:
The type of the scan scope configuration. Valid values:
1: scan by instance
3: scan all
Type.description_zh:
扫描范围配置类型。取值：
1：按实例扫描
3：全部扫描
